objective: Verify concrete finite controls and the applicable transfer between the one-sided problem and a full two-sketch 31-product instance. Pursue a lift if the 17-edge case is cheaper, otherwise identify exactly which rank-nine proof suffices.
status: Proved: All 65,536 one-sided Boolean sketches on four inputs and all 4,194,304 one-sided quadratic sketches on six inputs preserve the respective four- and eight-leaf optima for a nonsingular total. The seven-product even sketch has exact first-answer costs nine and seven, and a rank-nine one-sided lower bound implies a 512-case minimum over all two-mask choices on 31 products.
title: Check finite one-sided examples and the transfer to 31 products
